beats.headline: An Enemy of the Church tattoo
beats.text: Saferoom paperwork. Crawler Carl comes out of this one with a fresh Enemy of the Church tattoo, awarded for defiling a shrine of Diwata, and with a piece of advice from a professional who has watched several seasons of this: steer well clear of dryads, and steer further clear of Diwata herself. He takes the tattoo. I have no record of him taking the advice.

beats.headline: Marked for death, mid-raid
beats.text: A raid on a church is in progress when the notification lands on Crawler Carl: Diwata has entered the realm, and he is marked for death. That is the arithmetic of defiling a shrine. The god whose shrine it was is now on this floor, in person, with a grudge and a name to attach it to. Continue the raid, crawler. The mark does not expire because you are busy.

beats.headline: She has somewhere else to be
beats.text: She comes out of the church and runs, past the party, away, which is not what a marked crawler expects from a god with his name on a list. Samantha explains it. Diwata gives birth to new forest creatures, whole new kinds of them, and the rest of the pantheon finds this distasteful. Her sponsor is Circe Took of the Dark Hive, Hunter Vrah's mother. So Diwata is crossing this floor to reach Vrah, and the crawler she marked can wait his turn. I did not write this floor. I only run it.

beats.headline: The birthing is a spell
beats.text: The Sledge reports baby mantises outside the castle, everywhere, in numbers. Mordecai supplies the ruling that goes with it: Diwata's birthing is a spell, and a spell runs until it is finished casting. The five-minute limit that governs every other deity on this floor does not apply to a god in labour. She stays. They keep coming. Somebody should have read the terms.

beats.headline: Knocked out beneath the ballroom
beats.text: Somebody reached the castle's security room before Samantha did: five guards dead in their chairs, heads severed, the hunters' ballroom unshielded, the goodwill interface's crystal taken, still running on its capacitor. Mantises. Carl works it out: Diwata is in the castle, and she comes for the room when Samantha puts the crystals back. Samantha locks her out, and when the door breaks, bites down on a mouthful of soul crystals. The blast opens the floor between two ballrooms. Diwata is knocked out, still giving birth.

beats.headline: Boss battle, and a sponsor's own children
beats.text: Boss battle: crawlers, hunters, Queen Imogen and Diwata, all in one arena, and the audience gets exactly what it paid for. Princess Donut takes Laundry Day to level fifteen and strips the god-armour off Circe Took, and Circe, unarmoured, is torn apart by the mantis children she paid to have. There is a lesson in that about sponsorship. I will not be the one to say it out loud.
